intro: Blushing kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are shy, bashful Japanese-style text faces — rosy cheeks drawn with characters like ⁄ ⁄ and 〃 to show a flustered, embarrassed, or lovestruck moment. A blushing kaomoji such as (⁄ ⁄•⁄ω⁄•⁄ ⁄) or ( 〃▽〃) is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and messages. Browse by mood below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "blushing kaomoji," "blush kaomoji," or "shy kaomoji," every face here is free to copy and paste.
